notes.title: The Lumines Arise Demo is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43005846/520d53e65ccafa322cb0f2bb8bbd016a5c6fb458.png[/img]

A demo of Lumines Arise is available now until September 3 on Steam! Feel the good vibes (cuz let's face it, we all need more of that, right?) with these Demo features:

[list]
[*] Three-stage single-player Demo (featuring various stages from Journey mode)
[*] Burst Battle online multiplayer mode
[*] Tutorial to learn the basic gameplay of Lumines Arise
[/list]

Download it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847360/Lumines_Arise_Demo

Then be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370000/Lumines_Arise]Wishlist Lumines Arise on Steam[/url], 'cuz we also just announced a release date: November 11, 2025. If you've enjoyed Enhance's game catalog in the past, you're sure to dig this one too.

notes.content:

[h2]ːsteamthumbsupː *EXTENDED* Pre-orders open until Dec. 24., 11:59 PM PT[/h2] 
[b]Pre-order here by Christmas:[/b] https://www.cookandbecker.com/en/campaign/19/sounds-and-visions-enhance-at-10.html

From Rez Infinite making history by winning the first-ever Best VR Game award at The Game Awards to the unforgettable unveiling of the Tetris Effect announcement trailer in 2018, Enhance has a lot to celebrate these past 10 years.

Journey through a decade of Enhance's innovative gaming experiences with the SOUNDS AND VISIONS: ENHANCE AT 10 limited edition boxed set and vinyl collection.

The Sounds and Visions: Enhance at 10 collection offers two unique boxed sets, each with its own special content. These sets can be purchased individually or together. Both sets are available to [b]pre-order exclusively from Cook & Becker until December 25, 2024[/b].

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43005846/531142d8cdf6185ca06c166da94b3cb9bab2c89f.jpg[/img]
[b]The Sounds and Visions: Enhance At 10 Boxed Set by Cook & Becker includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Boxed set signed by Tetsuya Mizuguchi
[*] Sounds and Visions: An Oral History of Enhance book
[*] Hydelic At 10: CD featuring select tracks from Tetris Effect: Connected and Rez Infinite
[*] Rez Infinite Laser-etched Glass Sculpture
[*] Two giclee art prints with certificate of authenticity signed by Takashi Ishihara
[*] Ships Summer 2025
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43005846/d536989173da3081235ae8a023e5905fb5f32509.jpg[/img]
[b]The Enhance Soundworks Collection Boxed Set by Lost in Cult Records includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Vinyl boxed set signed by Tetsuya Mizuguchi
[*] 9xLPs (180g vinyl) with music from Tetris Effect: Connected, Rez Infinite, Lumines Remastered, and HUMANITY
[*] The Enhance Soundworks liner booklet
[*] Enhance Iconography turntable slipmat
[*] Enhance Iconography poster
[*] Enhance Iconography pin collection
[*] Ships Spring 2025
[/list]
For the full tracklist of each vinyl record, visit: https://www.cookandbecker.com/en/article/397/celebrating-10-years-of-enhance.html

The vinyl collection includes the original Rez soundtrack, songs from Lumines Remastered by Takayuki Nakamura, Hydelic compositions from Rez Infinite (Area X) and Tetris Effect: Connected, and music from HUMANITY by JEMAPUR.

[h1]Presenting Sounds & Visions: Enhance at 10[/h1]

Happy 10th anniversary to us!

Formed in 2014 by visionary Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Enhance is synonymous with transcendent interactive experiences that blur the line between video games, art, sound, and design. From the pulsing techno space-scapes of Rez Infinite to the expansive, ever—evolving visuals and challenge of Tetris® Effect: Connected and games like Lumines Remastered, and HUMANITY, Enhance occupies a wholly unique place in the culture of interactive entertainment.

To mark the 10 year anniversary, we are collaborating with Cook and Becker and Lost In Cult Records to present SOUNDS & VISIONS: ENHANCE AT 10—a celebration of the sights, sounds, works and stories that have defined the first decade of our company.

notes.title: Introducing the Tetris® Block Party - Celebrating 40 years of Tetris
notes.content:
[url=start.gg/tetris][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456889/5c307a99d1b561f57deb944eecf656bee17e2e60.png[/img][/url]

The Tetris 40th anniversary celebration continues with Tetris Block Party!

Enjoyed by fans around the world, Tetris continues to attract new players of all ages and cultures. In this unique one-of-a-kind setting, the Tetris Block Party will feature titles from the past and present, connecting Tetris players from different generations all over the world. 

[h2]Tetris Block Party [/h2]

Over the course of three weekends starting July 19, 2024, Enhance will host and broadcast a series of events for players of all skill levels and viewers. 

Event details including featured Tetris games, schedule and registration can be found at the official Start.gg Event page: [url=https://www.start.gg/tournament/tetris-block-party/details]start.gg/tetris[/url]

[b]Featuring Iconic Tetris games[/b] - Bring together the entire Tetris community for the ultimate Tetris party!
[list]
[*] Tetris (Game Boy™ - Nintendo Switch Online)
[*] Tetris (Nintendo Entertainment System™)
[*] Tetris The Grand Master, Tetris The Absolute The Grand Master 2 PLUS
[*] Tetris Effect: Connected
[*] Puyo Puyo Tetris 2
[/list]
[b]Party Nights[/b] - Community multiplayer lobbies and single player showcases where everyone can get involved. Participants and viewers can enter livestream giveaways.

If you would like to participate in the live streaming of Party Nights, please join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/enhance]Enhance Discord[/url].

[b]Online Tournaments[/b] - Online tournaments will be held for Tetris Effect: Connected and Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 (Tetris only, Nintendo Switch version). Players of all skill levels from around the world are invited to participate. For more information on the tournaments, please visit the [url=https://www.start.gg/tournament/tetris-block-party/]Tetris Block Party Start.gg page[/url].

[h2]Tetris Block Party Live Schedule[/h2]

[b][u]Party Nights (Livestreams start at 3:00 PM PT / 6:00 PM ET)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] July 19: Tetris (Game Boy™ - Nintendo Switch Online), Tetris (Nintendo Entertainment System™)
[*] July 26: Tetris The Grand Master, Tetris The Absolute The Grand Master 2 PLUS
[*] August 2: Tetris Effect: Connected (Team game modes), Tetris.com, Tetris Mobile Showcase
[/list]

[b][u]Online Tournament (Livestreams start at 5:00 PM PT / 8:00 PM ET)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] July 20: Tetris Effect: Connected (Classic Score Attack)
[*] July 27: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 (Tetris only, Nintendo Switch version only)
[*] August 3: Tetris Effect: Connected (Zone Battle)
[/list]

For online tournament qualifying schedule, rules details, and registration, visit: [url=https://www.start.gg/tournament/tetris-block-party/details]https://www.start.gg/tournament/tetris-block-party/details[/url]

🙂Producer, Tetsuya Mizuguchi (@Mizuguchitter)
💦Producer, Mark MacDonald (@markmacd)

notes.title: Get ready! Humanity launches May 16
notes.content:
Looking for a new Shiba-Action-Puzzle game? Humanity comes to Steam on May 16. Playable on desktop, laptop, Steam Deck, in VR—wherever you're playing your Steam library, we're there. 

We wanted to announce Humanity’s launch date with a trailer that truly reflects the game: fun, a bit weird (in a good way!) and starring an adorable lil’ Shiba Inu. Oh, and importantly: clearly, undeniably Japanese.

[previewyoutube=Ro3SkFl_huQ;full][/previewyoutube]
What better way to do that than to recreate the wild—and brilliant—Japanese PlayStation ad campaigns of the PS1 and PS2 era? We’ve been incredibly flattered to hear Humanity compared to classics of this era like Intelligent Cube, Echochrome, and Devil Dice (among others), even Katamari Damacy and Parappa the Rapper – all fresh and unique designer-led games out of Japan that broke new ground and did it with style. And whether you share that nostalgia or not, or were even gaming back then, we hope you’ll enjoy that same spirit in Humanity: stylish and different, but with a deeply satisfying game at the core. 

Interested? Be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581480/Humanity/]wishlist the game on the HUMANITY Store Page[/url] if you haven't yet. And tell everyone you know!

notes.title: Sign-ups for the Tetris Effect: Connected World Championships are now open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456889/2750934e7d76910a7362ae25481231fe739c921a.png[/img]

Enhance proudly announces that registrations for the 2022 Tetris® Effect: Connected World Championship (TECWC) events are now open. For the tournament’s second year, we’re mixing up the action with two events designed to appeal to the competitive and casual Tetris communities and all skill levels: the Tri-Effect-A and Connected 2022.

[h3][b]TRI-EFFECT-A[/b][/h3]

Things kick off with the Tri-Effect-A, a tournament that will test players' skills in three of Tetris Effect: Connected’s multiplayer modes: Zone Battle, Classic Score Attack, and Score Attack. High placement in a game mode bracket qualifies the player for the multi-mode main event to crown the true all-around Tetris Effect: Connected World Champion! Each game mode will have a separate bracket divided into tiers based on skill level. Participants of the Tri-Effect-A event will compete for over $2,000 in prizes and giveaways!

Sign-ups are available now at [url=https://www.tetriseffect.game/tournaments]www.tetriseffect.game/tournaments[/url], which also contains additional information on match formats, rules, prizing info, and more.

The tournament will be run via the Enhance Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/enhance]https://discord.gg/enhance[/url]), where players can find their matches, watch streams and speak to tournament staff. Matches will be broadcast in English on the CTWC Twitch channel ([url=https://twitch.tv/ClassicTetris]https://twitch.tv/ClassicTetris[/url]), alongside a Japanese broadcast on the Enhance Experience Twitch channel ([url=https://twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience]https://twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience[/url]). 

[b]Tri-Effect-A 2022 Schedule[/b]

8/17 - Registration Opens
8/31, 6 pm PDT - Registration Closes

9/01 - Tri-Effect-A Qualifier Begins
9/21 - Tri-Effect-A Qualifier Deadline for all modes (Tier 1 bracket)
9/24 - Zone Battle Finals
9/30 - Score Attack Finals

10/01 - Classic Score Attack Finals
10/08 - Tri-Effect-A Grand Finals
10/15 - Showmatches live at CTWC

[h3][b]CONNECTED 2022[/b][/h3]

Connected 2022 is a second event under the Tetris Effect: Connected World Championship. This year, we’re hosting an online invitational featuring the first-ever team competition in the game’s co-op Connected Vs. mode. In Collaboration with the Classic Tetris World Championship (CTWC), we will also be hosting an offline event at the Portland Retro Gaming Expo.

[b]Connected 2022 Schedule[/b]

9/23 - *Special Exhibition* Connected Vs. Invitational Stream
10/15 - Connected Vs. Tournament at CTWC

notes.title: Weekend Rituals - Unlock new AVATARS!
notes.content:
Tetris Effect: Connected has a “Weekend Ritual” event that runs every weekend for 24 hours! We're going to take a moment to explain what these events are, how they work, what you can gain from them, and some information to find out about our new [b]special clues[/b]!

[h3]Let’s learn how it works[/h3]

For 24 hours from noon UTC Saturday to noon UTC Sunday every weekend, the community works together to reach 100% of the Ritual Goal, which will unlock special in-game AVATARS! To participate, all you need to do is play the featured EFFECT MODE in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456889/d423f3369e0c4e09396fd018243ff398c89cb9dd.png[/img]

The event cycles through [i]CLASSIC, ADVENTUROUS, FOCUS and RELAX[/i] Effect Modes each week.

If the community reaches the goal by the end of the event, you'll get your in-game avatar during the following week, so make sure you log in after the event to see if the goal was met!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40456889/9dff4069b7b8c9bc1317c988e9a685e8e592e46b.png[/img]

The avatars run on a cycle, and there's a lot of them! To celebrate the Steam launch, we're going to be adding an extra little incentive to shake things up. Starting this week, we're going to be providing clues as to what the avatar will be each week on our Twitter account, so make sure you follow us to look for the clues!

Enhance Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/enhance_exp]https://twitter.com/enhance_exp[/url]

notes.title: Tetris Effect: Connected comes to Steam on August 18th with a 25%-off discount!
notes.content:
Tetris Effect: Connected will be launching on Steam on the 18th of August with a 25% off launch Discount, and a free Digital Deluxe DLC upgrade for a limited time -- alongside the free update to ALL existing platforms on the same day!

[b]Why did it get pushed back from late July?[/b]

After such a successful beta with lots of feedback, we realized we would need a little more time to get bugs squashed, and to ultimately deliver a higher quality game. Cross-platform multiplayer with VR is a huge technical challenge, and giving our players the best experience possible is very important to us. So while we know it may be a little annoying -- we think the wait is going to be worth it!

To celebrate the long-awaited Steam launch, we’re going to be offering a 25% off discount for the first two weeks. You’ll also get the “Digital Deluxe” version alongside the base game at no extra charge!

[b]The Digital Deluxe DLC includes:[/b]
